ehdr = e_ident + struct.pack('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH',
    3,        # e_type: ET_DYN (shared object)
    0xB7,     # e_machine: EM_AARCH64
    1,        # e_version
    0,        # e_entry
    64,       # e_phoff (program headers right after ELF header)
    0,        # e_shoff
    0,        # e_flags
    64,       # e_ehsize
    56,       # e_phentsize
    1,        # e_phnum (one PT_NOTE)
    64,       # e_shentsize
    0,        # e_shnum
    0,        # e_shstrndx
)

# Build the note content

note = struct.pack('<III', 4, len(buildid), 3) + note_name + buildid
